bio.text: Chris Mathis was appointed to the Arizona House of Representatives in 2021 and elected in 2022 to a full term representing Legislative District 18; he lives in Tucson.
He is a lawyer who practices elder law and is a Professor of Practice at the University of Arizona's James E. Rogers College of Law, where he teaches health care law and policy and aging.

He earned a Master in Public Administration from the Harvard Kennedy School, a Master in Public Health from the Harvard School of Public Health, and law and undergraduate degrees from the University of Illinois.
